skills.name: wayfinder
skills.en: Map a large, foggy effort as decision tickets and settle them one at a time
skills.zh: 把大而模糊的工作画成决策地图，逐张解决待决问题

skills.name: triage
skills.en: Sort issues others filed: reproduce, dedupe, turn into agent-ready briefs
skills.zh: 整理别人提的 issue：复现、去重、写成 agent 可接手的说明

skills.name: prototype
skills.en: Throwaway code that answers one design question, logic or UI
skills.zh: 写一次性代码回答一个设计问题，分逻辑原型和 UI 原型

skills.name: retro
skills.en: After a session, improve the agents' environment, not the code
skills.zh: 一段工作后复盘，改进 agent 的工作环境而不是代码

skills.name: teach
skills.en: A separate learning workspace with lessons, practice and a record
skills.zh: 独立的学习工作区：分课讲解、练习和学习记录

skills.name: wizard
skills.en: An interactive bash wizard for steps only a human can do
skills.zh: 生成交互式 bash 向导，带人完成只能亲手做的步骤

skills.name: pr
skills.en: A PR body: before/after evidence and which changes are one-way doors
skills.zh: 规范 PR 正文：改动前后对比，标出不可回退的改动

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.en: Vocabulary for deep modules: small interfaces, where seams go
skills.zh: 深模块设计词汇：小接口、深实现、seam 放在哪

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.en: Survey the codebase for modules worth deepening, with a comparison report
skills.zh: 扫描代码库，找出值得加深的模块并出对比报告

skills.name: to-questionnaire
skills.en: Turn a question you cannot answer into a questionnaire for an expert
skills.zh: 把自己答不了的问题变成问卷，交给懂行的人填写

skills.name: wait-what
skills.en: The last reply did not land: have it re-pitched
skills.zh: 上一条回复没看懂时，让 agent 换种说法重讲

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.en: How to write skills, AGENTS.md and briefs that agents follow
skills.zh: 怎么写 agent 能照做的 skill、AGENTS.md 和 brief
